items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Chauncey Horton was in Jimmy Hamilton -- the chair that Jimmy Hamilton later took. Chauncey Horton came in when Barney left... And, of course, the trumpets was Rex -- Taft Jordan had come in the band. Taft was there, Rex Stewart; Ray Nance was there and Shorty.

ctx.x: It had Claude Jones on trombone and a guy named Chauncy -- I forget his last name -- was on trumpet until they got Nesbitt. They got Nesbitt from a carnival.
Yes, but what was Nesbitt's full name?
